name: Zhichang shi Wo de Hougōng🔞
source:
After being unreasonably criticised by your manager, you decided to fight back. Unexpectedly, this attracted your female colleagues. Could it be that a chance to fulfill your fantasy of having a workplace harem?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2434160/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在被上司无理苛责后，身为上班族的你决定不再忍耐、果断还击，没想到这一举动反而意外地征服了公司里的OL女同事们。难道说，实现职场后宫幻想的契机就此降临了吗？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2434160/]Steam[/url]]
